mapper.update: UPDATE gb_device_channel SET tree_path = '' WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND tree_path <> ''

UPDATE gb_device_channel SET tree_path = CONCAT('/', #{deviceId}, '/', channel_id) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND tree_path = '' AND (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id = '' OR parent_id = '0' OR parent_id = #{deviceId})

UPDATE gb_device_channel c JOIN gb_device_channel p ON p.device_id = c.device_id AND p.parental = 1 AND p.channel_id = c.parent_id SET c.tree_path = CONCAT(p.tree_path, '/', c.channel_id) WHERE c.device_id = #{deviceId} AND c.tree_path = '' AND p.tree_path <> ''
AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.tree_path) + CHAR_LENGTH(c.channel_id) + 1 <= 512

UPDATE gb_device_channel c SET tree_path = concat(p.tree_path, '/', c.channel_id) FROM gb_device_channel p WHERE c.device_id = #{deviceId} AND c.tree_path = '' AND p.device_id = c.device_id AND p.parental = 1 AND p.channel_id = c.parent_id AND p.tree_path <> '' AND length(p.tree_path) + length(c.channel_id) + 1 <= 512
UPDATE gb_device_channel SET tree_path = CONCAT('/', #{deviceId}, '/', channel_id) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND tree_path = ''
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gb_device_channel WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND tree_path <> ''

SELECT id, device_id AS deviceId, channel_id AS channelId, report_name AS reportName, name, parental, status, source, ptz_type AS ptzType, parent_id AS parentId, tree_path AS treePath FROM gb_device_channel WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND parent_id IN #{pid} ORDER BY parental DESC, channel_id ASC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(tree_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 2), '/', 1) AS code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM gb_device_channel WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND parental = 0 AND tree_path LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '/%') GROUP BY 1
